### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning        |
| ----- | ------ | -------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | nose           |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to smell (tr.) |
| ~a    | *psv.* | smelled        |
### Implied meaning
- smell, scent
### Etymology
#### Glyph
oracle bone script of 自 (originally meaning "nose", not "myself").
Streams of air are placed in the nostrils.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* f=flow
